newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Pamplona not to invite Clinton to bull run.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Pamplona not to invite Clinton to bull run.

text.p: The Spanish city of Pamplona said on Thursday it would not invite Bill Clinton to its bull running festival in July because King Juan Carlos had asked the U.S. president to holiday with him at the same time.
The king has invited Clinton to spend a few days at the royal palace on the Mediterranean island of Majorca ahead of the July 8-9 NATO summit in Madrid.
"We are not inviting Clinton to Pamplona because the king and queen have invited him to Majorca on the same dates and it would not be appropriate," a Pamplona official said.
Pamplona's municipality said on Wednesday it was considering inviting Clinton to the annual nine-day running of the bulls which coincides with the NATO summit.

During the 400-year-old festival, fighting bulls charge through the town's narrow cobbled streets to an arena where they are killed in bullfights. Almost every year, one or two onlookers are trampled by bulls during the run.
The White House has not said whether Clinton will accept the king's invitation to take a break in Spain before the summit.
